The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他一次试一试有些植物的叶，吃得又新鲜又甜：有一次；试了试，了completed; 叶子；吃起来
- 煮这些叶以后，他一喝就知道他发现新的茶叶：煮了，了completed; 叶子

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 吃得又新鲜又甜：觉得又新鲜又甜，the structure with 得 describes the degree or result of eating, but “fresh” and “sweet” describe the leaves; use a perception verb to introduce the character’s evaluation. [rule: none]
Run 2: 吃得又新鲜又甜：吃起来又新鲜又甜，Use 起来 when describing how food tastes; 新鲜 and 甜 describe the leaves’ taste, not the manner of eating. [rule: none]
Run 3: 吃得又新鲜又甜：吃起来又新鲜又甜，吃起来 introduces an evaluation of how food tastes; 吃得 cannot be used to describe the leaves’ flavour in this structure. [rule: none]
